title: Transcript summary prompts
description: The prompts behind each section of an end-of-meeting summary. Each section has a title and a prompt; the number in front of the title orders the sections of the summary. Use {transcript} where the meeting transcript goes. Turning a shipped section off stores it as NONE, which the summarizer skips.

^[0-9]+#.+$.title: Prompt
^[0-9]+#.+$.description: Use {transcript} where the meeting transcript goes.
